issues.on_page: Loan collections 58,998 (p5, p12); Statement of Activities p2 lists Economic development charges for services 58,998
issues.issue: These are LB840 loan repayments. The report's own Statement of Activities counts them as economic-development charges for services, so 'other' is not the only possible category (repayment of loan principal is arguably not revenue at all). Same for detail[111] (detail_category miscellaneous revenue). Review flag is present.

issues.on_page: Capital outlay (Administrative 12,109; Fire 47,507; Ambulance 4,340; Park 10,500; Pool 28,700; Sports Complex 3,270)
issues.issue: The schedule does not say what the capital outlay was for, but every department's Capital outlay line except Skylon is mapped to equipment purchases without a review flag (it is disclosed only in notes). The detail_category is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds: operating 322,876; capital and related financing (215,885); investing (698); beginning cash 1,168,521; ending cash 1,274,814
issues.issue: Business-type funds are on the accrual basis and a full cash-flow statement is printed (pp8-9). It is left out because the top-level basis is 'cash' (the governmental funds are modified cash). That follows the GAAP-only rule, and the figures are copied into notes, but the user may want proprietary filled for this mixed-basis city.

issues.on_page: General Fund departments: Administrative (643,917), Fire +77,265, Skylon +460,748 = net (105,904); Debt Service (77,265); Street +183,169
issues.issue: Gross transfers are recorded from the fund-statement columns (General net out 105,904 + Debt Service out 77,265 = 183,169). The departmental schedule shows the 77,265 from Debt Service actually goes into the General Fund (Fire), and the General Fund sends 183,169 to Street. Between funds the gross figures would be 260,434 each way. The net is zero either way and the amount is marked computed, so this is informational only.
